description: This is a Perl script used for downloading files with support for multiple mirrors, checksum verification, and custom download tools. It handles complex download logic including local and project mirrors, and integrates with environment variables and configuration files.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from a file and environment variables to compile a list of mirror URLs.

methods.name: projectsmirrors
methods.description: Reads project-specific mirror URLs from a JSON file and appends them to the mirror list.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks if a program exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the appropriate hash command based on checksum length.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks if a specific download tool is available and matches the expected version line.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Selects the download tool based on user preference or available utilities.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command for downloading files using the selected tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading from a specified mirror, verifying hashes, and managing local file placement.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary download files and hash files to clean the environment.
